name: Assign Jira Issue
description: Assigns a Jira issue to a user, or to the current user when the assignee is 'me' or 'currentUser'. Use to assign, reassign, or take an issue.
author: anything-jira

input.hint: Base URL of your Jira Server / Data Center instance.
Jira Data Center Personal Access Token. Sent as a Bearer token. Stored locally in this skill's plugin.json.

issueKey.description: The Jira issue key, e.g. 'ENG-123'. Required.

assignee.description: The username to assign to. Use 'me' or 'currentUser' to assign to yourself. Use 'unassign' to clear the assignee. Required.
